```{python}
import json, os, pandas as pd, yaml
from pathlib import Path
REL = Path(os.environ.get("DRR_RELEASE", "../data/release"))   # override for dry runs
schema = yaml.safe_load(open("../docs/schema.yaml"))
obs = pd.read_csv(REL / "observations.csv", parse_dates=["survey_date"])
qa = pd.read_csv(REL / "qa_summary.csv")
meta = json.loads((REL / "metadata.json").read_text())
passed = obs[obs["qa_flag"].isna()].copy()
passed["local_date"] = (pd.to_datetime(passed["survey_date"], utc=True)
                        .dt.tz_convert(schema["timezone"]).dt.date)
REACHES = list(schema["domains"]["reach"])
from IPython.display import Markdown
def md(df, **kw):
    return Markdown(df.to_markdown(index=False, **kw))
```

## Methods
**Survey design.** <!-- reaches, landmarks, walk direction, visual count protocol -->
Index stations (each visit: 10-minute timed visual scan from bank or bridge):

```{python}
md(pd.DataFrame([{"station": k, "reach": schema["domain_filters"]["station"]["map"][k],
                  "location": v.split(": ", 1)[-1]}
                 for k, v in schema["domains"]["station"].items()]))
```

**Data collection.** Survey123 form with coded domains, conditional required fields,
range constraints, a cascading reach → station select, and a two-tier GPS check: the form
blocks fixes worse than `{python} schema["gps_accuracy_block_m"]` m and QA flags anything over
`{python} schema["gps_accuracy_warn_m"]` m.

**Quality control.** Automated post-collection checks (`scripts/qa_pipeline.py`):

```{python}
md(qa[qa["n"] > 0][["check", "n", "description"]])
```

Flagged records stay in the package with their codes in `qa_flag`; the results below use
QA-passed records only.

## Results

**Effort.** Station visits per reach. A visit with only "no fish seen" records is a measured zero.

```{python}
v = passed.groupby(["reach", "station", "local_date"])["obs_type"].agg(lambda t: (t == "no_fish").all())
eff = (v.groupby("reach").agg(visits="size", zero_visits="sum")
       .reindex(REACHES, fill_value=0).reset_index())
md(eff)
```

**Counts by reach and species** (sum over QA-passed records; redds use `redd_count`).

```{python}
fish = passed[passed["obs_type"].isin(["live_fish", "carcass", "redd"])].copy()
fish["n"] = fish["count"].where(fish["obs_type"] != "redd", fish["redd_count"])
if len(fish):
    t = (fish.pivot_table(index=["reach", "species"], columns="obs_type", values="n",
                          aggfunc="sum", fill_value=0)
         .reindex(columns=["live_fish", "carcass", "redd"], fill_value=0).astype(int))
    t = t.reset_index().merge(pd.DataFrame({"reach": REACHES}), how="right").fillna(
        {"species": "none observed", "live_fish": 0, "carcass": 0, "redd": 0})
    out = md(t.astype({"live_fish": int, "carcass": int, "redd": int}))
else:
    out = "No fish, carcasses, or redds in QA-passed records (zero counts are valid data)."
out
```

**Live fish by survey date and reach.**

```{python}
live = passed[passed["obs_type"] == "live_fish"]
ts = (live.pivot_table(index="local_date", columns="reach", values="count",
                       aggfunc="sum", fill_value=0)
      .reindex(sorted(passed["local_date"].unique()), fill_value=0)
      .reindex(columns=REACHES, fill_value=0).astype(int))
md(ts.rename_axis("date").reset_index())
```
